label: Quote Card
description: Pull-quote social card — auto-wrapped quote, accent bar, attribution with an optional circular avatar; hand-tuned light/dark presets; lossless PNG still, aspect-safe from square to stories. Every line is editable on the canvas.

quote.label: Quote
quote.description: The quote body. Wrapped and sized to fit automatically — long quotes shrink, short quotes render large.

attribution.label: Attribution
attribution.description: Who said it — set bold under the accent bar. Clear it to leave the quote unattributed.

role.label: Role / source
role.description: A second line under the name — a title, handle, book or episode. Empty hides the line.

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.description: A photo of who said it, clipped to a circle beside the name. Drop an image on the name to add one.

quoteMark.label: Quote mark
quoteMark.description: Show the decorative opening-quote glyph above the quote.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Colour of the quote mark and the divider bar.

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Light or dark card — one click restyles the background and the ink together.

background.label: Background
background.description: The card colour. Overrides the preset's background; clear it to follow light / dark again.

ink.label: Ink
ink.description: Colour of the quote and the name; the role line keeps the preset's softer ink.

margin.label: Margin
margin.description: Space around the quote, as a share of the card's short edge — more margin leaves the words less room.
